CacheTokens.description: How many of a run's tokens its harness billed twice over. Absent entirely when the harness never reports cache activity, which is a different claim from a harness that checked and cached nothing. At least one side must be named: a value naming neither carries no information the field being absent does not already carry.

RunCost.description:
What one run cost, or why nobody can say.

A run whose harness prices nothing and a run whose harness prices everything but did
not price this one are two different facts, and a bare absent number carries neither.
A reader totalling an absent price as zero reports a harness as cheap when what it
actually did was decline to answer.

oneOf.description: The harness priced this run, and this is what it came to.

The harness prices no run at all, so this one has no cost to report and is not a
run that cost nothing. Named, so a report totalling a mixed history can say which
harness it cannot total.

SchemaVersion.description: Which shape of this artifact the document was written to. Absent means it predates stamping, which is shape 1.

description:
The shape a run's timing is written in, which is the shape every earlier release still
reads. `cost_usd` was that release's whole vocabulary for cost, so a run that carries a
price keeps publishing one; a run nobody priced has no number to put there, which is
what its absence has always meant.

cost.description:
What this run cost, or why nobody can say. Absent when the harness prices its runs
and did not price this one, which is a different fact from a harness that prices
none of them.

cost_usd.description:
The price alone, for readers written before `cost` could say why a run carries
none. Absent for exactly the runs that carry no price.
